title: Good Sequences
statementMd:
Squirrel Liss is interested in sequences. She also has preferences of integers. She thinks $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ are *good*.

Now she is interested in good sequences. A sequence $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*k*}$ is called *good* if it satisfies the following three conditions:

- The sequence is strictly increasing, i.e. $*x*_{*i*} < *x*_{*i* + 1}$ for each $*i*$ $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ *k* - 1)$.
- No two adjacent elements are coprime, i.e. $*gcd*(*x*_{*i*}, *x*_{*i* + 1}) > 1$ for each $*i*$ $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ *k* - 1)$ (where $*gcd*(*p*, *q*)$ denotes the greatest common divisor of the integers $*p*$ and $*q*$).
- All elements of the sequence are good integers.

Find the length of the longest good sequence.

## Input

The input consists of two lines. The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of good integers. The second line contains a single-space separated list of good integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ in strictly increasing order ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}; *a*_{*i*} < *a*_{*i* + 1}$).

## Output

Print a single integer — the length of the longest good sequence.

## Note

In the first example, the following sequences are examples of good sequences: [2; 4; 6; 9], [2; 4; 6], [3; 9], [6]. The length of the longest good sequence is 4.
statementZhMd:
Squirrel Liss 对序列很感兴趣。她还对整数有自己的偏好。她认为 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ 是*好的*。

现在，她对好序列感兴趣。若一个序列 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*k*}$ 满足以下三个条件，则称其为*好序列*：

- 序列严格递增，即对于每个 $*i*$ $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ *k* - 1)$，都有 $*x*_{*i*} < *x*_{*i* + 1}$。
- 任意两个相邻元素都不互质，即对于每个 $*i*$ $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ *k* - 1)$，都有 $*gcd*(*x*_{*i*}, *x*_{*i* + 1}) > 1$（其中 $*gcd*(*p*, *q*)$ 表示整数的最大公约数）。
- 序列中的所有元素都是好的整数。

请找出最长好序列的长度。

## 输入格式

输入由两行组成。第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示好的整数的数量。第二行包含一行以空格分隔的好的整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$，这些整数按严格递增顺序排列（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}; *a*_{*i* + 1}$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即最长好序列的长度。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，以下序列都是好序列的例子：[2; 4; 6; 9]、[2; 4; 6]、[3; 9]、[6]。最长好序列的长度为 4。
